sections.title: P4.3 — controlled-production gate
sections.text:
**Verdict:** production `NO-GO`; P4.3 terminal `Done with deviations` under D12. Controlled-production
traffic and the 72-hour observation window were not started and will not be provided by owner decision.

sections.title: What was authorized
sections.text:
The repository owner launched the exact P4.3 item and then explicitly required autonomous
continuation to the item result. The durable artifact binds that owner intent to run
`7d0523d4963f17012d11dcddb03760169bfcfe4e6ca97696c0c34ea9de769cd7`. The owner also explicitly
lowered only the route floor from `frontier/xhigh` to `frontier/high`; the plan Routing and the
provider-attested attempt now match. Traffic remains fail-closed until D10 has an exact
environment, crawler profile/filter, request ceiling and reversible stop action. It does not reuse
the earlier P4.1 live-probe scope as implicit production authority.

sections.title: Preflight result
sections.text:
P4.1 is terminal with resolved B2 and P4.2 is terminal GREEN. Task batch admission and
`pre_mutation` are also allowed. The actual production preflight is RED:

| Check | Result | Classification |
|:--|:--|:--|
| Production Compose render | exit 1 | `COMPOSE_PROJECT_NAME` is missing |
| Production Compose project | absent | only the local `agelto_dev` project is running |
| `.env.production` | absent | effective non-secret production config cannot be rendered |
| `docker/host/production-profile` | absent | no repository-owned target/operator binding |
| Remote Docker/SSH target | absent | `default` and `desktop-linux` are local Unix-socket contexts; no `/srv/agelto` checkout or SSH config exists |
| Horizon/config checks | exit 1 before exec | Compose interpolation failed before a target existed |
| Current immutable deployed image | absent | local `rehearsal-current` images are old, unpushed and not deployed |
| Crawler profile/filter/ceiling/stop action | unresolved | no exact D10 traffic scope exists |

All six declared preflight commands were executed. Each failed at the same Compose interpolation
boundary before any container command, network request, database write or storage operation.
Secret files were checked only for presence and their contents were not read.

sections.title: Maximum local rehearsal
sections.text:
The owner explicitly withheld production access and authorized the maximum safe local work. The
`agelto_dev` stack was therefore exercised as local-only evidence, never relabelled as production:

| Local carrier | Result |
|:--|:--|
| Runtime readiness | GREEN after recovery: database, cache, storage, release state, assets, Horizon and scheduler |
| Worker interruption/recovery | GREEN: 5 tests / 49 assertions plus durable recovery 3 / 11; SIGTERM, SIGKILL, Horizon restart and no-overlap proved |
| Focused fault/recovery tests | GREEN: 23 tests / 110 assertions |
| Storage outage/recovery | GREEN: stopped local MinIO; readiness failed only on storage with exit 1; restarted to healthy; full readiness returned exit 0 |
| Pipeline state | no stuck/anomalous states; local dataset empty |
| Crawler health | `not_enough_data`; no active fresh CSV profile |
| Targeted broad suite | GREEN: 868 tests / 3174 assertions in 63.41 s |
| Full application suite | GREEN: 1639 tests / 7441 assertions in 99.878 s (one framework warning, no failed test) |
| Composer audit / PHPStan / Pint | GREEN: no advisories, no PHPStan errors, Pint clean across 1547 files |
| Rector dry-run | RED: three already-dirty job files would migrate timeout properties to attributes; those unrelated owner changes were not rewritten by P4.3 |

Before the storage outage rehearsal, MinIO reported `XMinioStorageFull` because the root filesystem
was full. Only rebuildable Docker build cache and dangling images were pruned, reclaiming about
36.9 GB; named images and volumes were left intact. The filesystem then had 41,412,227,072 bytes
available (92% used), local buckets were verified idempotently, and readiness became GREEN. The
storage failure was then injected and recovered with an automatic restore trap.

No secret value, raw response body or signed query parameter was persisted in the evidence. Local
tooling used the existing credentials internally; their values were not recorded.

sections.title: Why production remains NO-GO
sections.text:
D10 requires a target-bound authorization and effective runtime evidence before traffic. Creating a
new local stack, inventing a crawler profile or treating the P4.1 verification probe as production
would change the authorized environment/scope. It would also fail to measure the target worker,
storage, latency and backlog that P4.3 exists to observe.

The 72-hour duration is therefore zero, all production metrics are uncollected, production
worker/storage fault tests are not run, and there is no selected source set to reconcile. The local
fault/recovery evidence above reduces implementation risk but cannot establish production backlog,
latency, external-source or target-storage behavior. This is an explained incomplete window, not a
waiver and not a synthetic production GREEN. D12 accepts the completed local-only scope as terminal
while preserving this missing production certification as an explicit deviation.

sections.title: Stop and rollback
sections.text:
No production request or write was started, no production service was interrupted, and no
production rollback is required. Locally, MinIO was deliberately stopped and restarted; the final
stack is healthy. Docker build cache and dangling images were removed and are recoverable by
rebuild/pull; named images and data volumes were not removed.

sections.title: Exact continuation
sections.text:
P4.3 is terminal with deviations. Continue with P4.4 immutable raw CSV/HTML evidence addressing.
Any future production certification requires a new explicit owner-authorized work item and cannot
retroactively turn this local-only evidence into production GO.

Machine evidence: `artifacts/P4-controlled-production.json`.
